jurisdiction: Personal Data Protection Agency in Bosnia and Herzegovina
applies_to: Public & private controllers and processors (incl. foreign firms targeting residents)
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, 72-hour breach notification, video surveillance & biometrics limits
data_categories: Personal data; special categories incl. biometric data
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Agency in Bosnia and Herzegovina (AZLP)
penalties_range: Up to BAM 40M or 4% global turnover
research_exemption: New 2025 law (Sl. glasnik BiH 12/25) contains special rules for academic and research activities; articles not confirmed (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Defined (inherited or acquired genetic characteristics from biological sample analysis) and listed as special category, new concept in 2025 law
notes: Replaced 2006 law (49/06); in force 8 Mar 2025; 2-year transition for existing processing
